roles.title: Senior / Principal Product Manager, Contract Orchestration

bullets: Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for Contract Orchestration, with a clear, opinionated view of where we beat incumbent CLMs
Ship AI that does the work: clause analysis, playbook-grounded redlines, contract generation, triage and routing, and metadata extraction accurate enough to trust
Own the full lifecycle, from intake and negotiation to the repository, contract families, renewals, and contract-to-spend compliance
Work directly with customers to ship features that reduce contract cycle times and increase contract visibility and compliance
Build agents and own the AI quality bar end to end: evals, guardrails, and feedback loops
Set the vision and multi-quarter strategy for a major area of Zip’s AI product, translating a fast-changing technology landscape into a clear, opinionated view on what to build…
Partner with engineering, design, and AI research to ship sophisticated agent capabilities and turn them into concrete, high-value use cases that are accurate, reliable, and…
Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand user needs and gather feedback on our agents and chat experiences
Own the quality bar for AI experiences end to end, designing the evals, rollout gates, guardrails, and feedback loops that let customers trust agents to act on their behalf, and…
Roll up your sleeves wherever the team needs it, whether that’s sitting in on user research, debugging a quality issue, or reviewing agent outputs
Lead Zip’s authentication and security roadmap, including MFA, step-up MFA, Multi-IdP SSO, IP restrictions, anomaly detection, and account takeover prevention.
Define and drive strategy for Zip’s data governance, reporting and insights capabilities.
Own enterprise-grade permissions and access controls, ensuring clarity, auditability, and scalability for complex organizational structures.
Drive the strategy and execution for expanding Zip into new markets, verticals, and product categories.
Identify, validate, and launch new high-impact use cases that unlock growth opportunities.
Develop and test hypotheses through rapid experimentation, customer research, and market analysis.
Balance speed and scalability, ensuring new initiatives can evolve into durable, enterprise-ready product offerings.
Align the GTM, enablement, and sales strategies with our product strategy to drive the business success of new offerings
